name: Will removing a load-bearing wall affect my home's resale value?
description: Properly done load-bearing wall removal can increase resale value by creating open space. Improper work, however, can decrease value and create liabilities.

mainEntity.name: Will removing a load-bearing wall affect my home's resale value?

acceptedAnswer.text: When done correctly and with proper permits, removing a load-bearing wall to create an open-concept space can often increase a home's appeal and resale value, as it aligns with modern design preferences. However, if done improperly or without permits, it can significantly decrease value and create serious liabilities for future owners.
